description: Use this when you want to add a trader to your watchlist; returns your updated watch count (activity notifications are not available yet). You must have made a trade yourself and cannot watch yourself; to remove a trader use trader_unwatch.

auth_token.description: Session token for your X-verified account. Read it from the MT_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable; if it is not set, call trader_login first.
auth_token.title: Auth Token

target_handle.description: X handle of the trader to add to your watchlist, with or without @.
target_handle.title: Target Handle

name: trader_watch
